candidate_method.expanded_name: Thermodynamic Rotamer-Averaged Counterfactual Energy for Protein-Ligand mutation effects
candidate_method.core_definition: A shared atomic state-potential network scores rotamer ensembles for residue identities on the same WT protein-ligand backbone; mutation DDG is exactly G(mutant_state)-G(wild_type_state).
candidate_novel_combination: WT-complex-only counterfactual side-chain ensemble generation without mutant complex coordinates
drug-conditioned ligand-atom to side-chain-atom messages before pooling
rotamer free-energy marginalization rather than a single mutant conformation
shared residue-state potential that gives exact antisymmetry and exact single-site path closure by construction

locked_external_test.reference_model: PBCNet2.0 official weight reproduced on CPU
locked_external_test.homology_exclusion: all Platinum chains in a component with >=30% identity and >=80% shorter-chain coverage to any PBCNet2 WT chain are removed

counterfactual_structure.conformer_generator: RDKit ETKDGv3 free-amino-acid conformers aligned by N-CA-C to the WT backbone
counterfactual_structure.hydrogen_policy: heavy atoms only in learned contact messages
counterfactual_structure.reason_no_observed_wt_special_case: state representation must be independent of forward or reverse direction for exact antisymmetry

model.ensemble_aggregation: normalized negative logsumexp over conformer state energies
model.parameter_budget_rule: TRACE-PL and direct-pair neural comparator must be within 10% trainable parameters

phase_a_training.loss: Huber exact-label loss in Phase A

mandatory_comparators: ridge on mutation identity, mutation-ligand distance, ligand Morgan and residue physicochemical deltas
ExtraTrees on the same non-atomic features
matched-capacity direct-pair neural network without a shared state potential
official PBCNet2.0 on the locked 65-example external set
integrity_gates: all development and test structure-homology components disjoint
all train, validation and test groups disjoint in every fold
no test-label access before checkpoint selection
max absolute three-state path closure error <= 1e-6

mechanism_signal_gates.primary_full_beats_direct_pair_rmse: cluster-bootstrap 95% CI for RMSE_full-RMSE_direct_pair is below 0
mechanism_signal_gates.external_sota_gate: macro-target Pearson > 0.5450085629 and macro-target Spearman > 0.5296807359 on locked PBCNet2 65

decision_rule.open_multiseed_confirmation_only_if: all integrity gates and all development mechanism gates pass; external SOTA is evaluated once after model freeze
decision_rule.success_status: PHASE_A_SUPPORTED; OPEN_FIVE_SEED_CONFIRMATION; STILL_NO_SOTA CLAIM UNTIL CONFIRMATION
